stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): 30,030 applied, 22,798 admitted (76%), 1,850 enrolled (1,829 full-time + 21 part-time); counts from the NCES IPEDS 2025 Data Feedback Report, Figure 1 (chart data), and College Navigator shows the same 30,030 applicants, 76% admitted and 8% of admitted students enrolled. No readable current Common Data Set: Pace's 2025-2026 and 2024-2025 CDS links on pace.edu open a Microsoft sign-in page, so the international split, GPA distribution, waitlist, early-round counts and admission factors for those years are left blank (the older public 2023-2024 CDS is added as a separate year). SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (247 students = 13% sent SAT, 56 = 3% sent ACT); Pace is test-optional. College Navigator gives no combined SAT total. Undergraduate enrollment (8,038) and the 691 U.S. nonresident undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator shows nonresidents as 9% of undergraduates); the 14-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio is from College Navigator. Calendar is semester (the academic catalog lists a Fall 2026 Semester).

stats_extra.notes: Fall 2023 entering class from Pace's public 2023-2024 Common Data Set (C1): 28,469 applied, 21,961 admitted, 1,949 enrolled; the in-state, out-of-state and international columns add up to the totals (12,674 + 12,956 + 2,839 and 9,868 + 10,287 + 1,806). International (nonresident) first-years: 2,839 applied, 1,806 admitted (64%). The same applicants and admits appear in IPEDS ADM2023. C12 prints an average high school GPA of 3.3 (one decimal), reported by 99.9% of first-years. The CDS also lists a waitlist block (1,085 offered a place) whose admitted figure is inconsistent with the accepted figure, so waitlist counts are left out. This is an older year kept for the international figures; the newest figures are the fall 2024 IPEDS row.
